'''Ildisa''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] member of the [[Myyydril]] tribe. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], Ildisa's tribe dwelt within the [[Myyydril Caverns/Legends|Myyydril Caverns]] of the [[Kkowir Forest/Legends|Kkowir Forest]], on her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. She served was one of their mystics.
